enabled.description: Enable or disable the location service entirely.

backends.description: List of location backend modules to load.

default_backend.description: Name of the backend to use by default (must be present in backends).

pid_file.description: Absolute path to the PID file for the location service daemon.

backend_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a backend to initialize before failing.

rate_limit.description: Maximum number of position updates per second allowed from the service.

gnss_systems.description: GNSS constellations the hardware should track (e.g., GPS, GLONASS, Galileo).

mock_enabled.description: Enable mock location mode (useful for testing; ignored unless mock backend is loaded).

mock_latitude.description: Mock latitude in decimal degrees (used only in mock mode).

mock_longitude.description: Mock longitude in decimal degrees (used only in mock mode).

mock_altitude.description: Mock altitude in meters above sea level (used only in mock mode).

mock_speed.description: Mock speed in meters per second (used only in mock mode).

mock_heading.description: Mock heading in degrees (0° = North, 90° = East) (used only in mock mode).

mock_accuracy.description: Mock position accuracy in meters (used only in mock mode).

gpsd_host.description: Host or IP address of an external GPSD server (only used if gypsy backend is disabled and GPSD backend loaded).

gpsd_port.description: Port number of the external GPSD server.
